description: Official Kent State University wordmark files the ATR Lab uses, with their exact source and checksum. The files themselves are not in the skill: fetch them with scripts/official_assets.py fetch <id|all>, which verifies each SHA-256.
publisher: Kent State University, Division of University Communications and Marketing (UCM)

terms.summary: Kent State publishes these files for download on its brand site but states no redistribution license. All official marks and logos are registered trademarks of Kent State University and "may not be used without permission"; licensing requests go to the Office of General Counsel. So the skill ships this manifest and a fetch command, not the files.

stacked.sha256_note: checksum of the archive when retrieved; Kent State may re-zip it, so only the member checksums below are enforced

horizontal.sha256_note: checksum of the archive when retrieved; Kent State may re-zip it, so only the member checksums below are enforced

not_listed: Black, CMYK reverse and JPG versions (in the same archives; not used by the lab)
Horizontal 2G-RGB PNG (UNIVERSITY in gold; the lab uses the 2G-CMYK PNG, which matches the 2-color EPS)
University Seal (permissions required), K Emblem and all athletics marks (the lab does not use them)

assets.label: Two-color: KENT STATE and UNIVERSITY in Kent State Blue, sunburst in Kent State Gold
assets.colors: Kent State Blue PMS 281 and Kent State Gold PMS 124 (EPS: spot colors)
assets.member: Kent State University Stacked/Kent State University Stacked,PNGs/kent_state_university_stacked_2-color.png

min_size.why: Kent State minimum: one inch with UNIVERSITY at least one inch long; UNIVERSITY spans 99.6% of the Stacked width. Screens: lab convention, UNIVERSITY at least 96 px.

clear_space.rule: Keep the height of the K in KENT clear on every side.

assets.intended_use: The default Kent State signature on white or mist: flyers, one-pagers, slides with a light background, documents, web pages. PNG: on-screen use and office files (300 ppi at 3.41 in wide; still 150 ppi or more up to 6.8 in wide on posters).
